# Sprint 6 · release state

Implementation branch is intentionally stacked on Sprint 5.

- Sprint 5: PR #69 → `main`
- Sprint 6: `sprint-6-polish-observability` → `sprint-5-handoff-qa`

This avoids publishing Sprint 6 before the handoff/runtime work it depends on. Once Sprint 5 is merged, Sprint 6 can be retargeted to `main`, revalidated, and then promoted.
